description: Widens image_style from 2 to 5 options (RFC 0008 follow-up: flat_comic_expressive doesn't suit every genre/content). Purely an enum widening -- every 1.1.0/1.0.0 artifact stays valid, no migrator needed. MINOR bump per RFC 0007.

brief.description: Plain-language ask, e.g. 'a documentary about the world's strangest airports'.

constraints.description: Hard requirements or exclusions stated by the human.

genre.description: The narrative shape narrative_story_architect and narration_script_writer should write to. moral_story (default when absent): a parable -- cold open, escalation, a low point, a turn, a payoff that reframes the opening. drama: conflict from the first line, heightened stakes, ends on an explicitly stated lesson (Dhar Mann-style). true_story: framed as a specific real incident, restrained/matter-of-fact voice, can end on an unresolved moral question rather than a tidy lesson. short_story: literary craft, twist or ironic ending, no moralizing.

image_style.description: The locked visual identity illustrated_scene_assets conditions every generated still on. When absent, the engine picks a genre-appropriate default (see service.ts GENRE_DEFAULT_STYLE) rather than always falling back to ink_wash_stickman. ink_wash_stickman: hand-drawn pen-and-ink, muted near-monochrome wash, faceless stick-figure humans, detailed environments/objects/animals -- the RFC 0008 house style, default for moral_story. flat_comic_expressive: flat vector illustration, bold black outlines, bright limited palette, simplified figures with expressive minimal faces -- default for drama. documentary_sketch: restrained charcoal/pencil reportage style, real human likeness rendered as sketch rather than photoreal, muted grays -- default for true_story. watercolor_storybook: soft painterly watercolor, warm pastel palette, gentle whimsical linework -- default for short_story. noir_charcoal: high-contrast dramatic charcoal/ink, heavy chiaroscuro shadow -- not a genre default, an explicit operator pick for suspense/thriller-leaning content.
